rows.text: • Updates full-year outlook to net sales growth of around 5%, net income per diluted share of $13.10 to $13.60, share repurchases increased to at least $500 million
• Third quarter outlook of net sales growth of 5% to 6%, net income per diluted share of $2.90 to $3.20, at least $100 million in share repurchases

For the year, we expect to grow sales and earnings per share, underpinned by double-digit operating margins, while delivering strong cash flow and returns of cash to shareholders through at least $500 million of share repurchases.
